text: Close the journal. Open the door. The mountain owes you a rematch.
The cabin will wait. It always does. It has excellent manners.
I died famous for luck. You will live famous for trying. Better deal.
Bones mend. Pride mends slower. Both mend if you keep moving.
When in doubt, take the shiny thing and apologize to history.
Leave the mountain something to miss. Preferably not your hat.
Failure is a footnote. Footnotes are where the truth hides. Congratulations.
The engraving says how dare you. Wear that energy into the next room.
Stand where the light is thin and your luck is thick.
Hunger is a strategy. So is soup. I endorse soup.
If you see a shortcut, assume it sees you first.
Bank early. Brag later. Bragging early is how I met the floor.
The Spin does not care about your feelings. Charm it anyway.
Write the bruise down. Future you will call it foreshadowing.
A quiet bell helps. A quieter ego helps more. I mastered neither.
Keep your heels pointed homeward even when your head is pointed elsewhere.
Monsters improve you. You improve the furniture. Fair trade.
One more delve. Always one more. That is the whole religion.
Dust yourself off with dignity, or with a rag. I prefer the rag. It's honest.
The will said everything. It did not say "easily." Fine print of the heart.
Soft moss is a trap. Hard stone is honesty. Prefer honesty, briefly.
Never apologize to a boulder. It will take it personally and roll.
If the lantern goes out, you still have spite. Spite is a renewable resource.
A trophy unbanked is a story unfinished. Finish loudly next time.
Tips from the deceased: stay curious, stay greedy, stay vaguely upright.
I met every brick in this place personally. Some of them remember fondly.
Whisper a vow, then shout a Spin. Order matters.
Your pockets are finite. Your next attempt is not.
The belly of the mountain has no manners. Reply in kind, then leave.
Falling with style still counts as falling. Falling with notes counts as science.
Do not open the left-hand drawer. That advice has outlived me. Heed it.
Home is where the Cabinet is. The Cabinet is where the proof is.
Counting to four is plenty. Beyond that is showing off.
Hold the Block for the thing that laughs. Everything else is practice.
If you can still limp, you can still learn. Limping is underrated scholarship.
A good plan survives contact. A great plan apologizes and revises.
The mountain keeps what you drop. So don't drop your nerve.
Bring biscuits for {nib}. Bring stubbornness for yourself. Priorities.
Defeat is temporary. Embarrassment is archival. File yours under "research."
Never trust a corridor that smiles. Corridors should not have opinions.
When the wheel goes quiet, listen for your own breathing. Then ignore it and try again.
Luck prefers the prepared. I preferred lunch. We compromised.
Sleep on it. The bruise will still be there; you'll just be ruder to it.
A monster that beats you once has taught you its name. Charge interest later.
Always map the exit before the entrance. I never did. Look how wise I sound.
Pack light regrets. They bruise less than heavy ones.
Courage is continuing after you've already explained yourself to the floor.
If at first you don't succeed, invent a reason you meant to fall.
Get back up. The mountain is terrible at keeping score.
A setback is just a setback with better lighting.

Hey friends — thanks for playtesting my game, {game_title}.
Just a few notes before you jump in.

First. This game is in early prototype mode. The things I most want to hear from your feedback are about what is fun, what is boring, what is confusing, and what things you think I should add to the game.
Second. Be honest and picky! You don't need to consider anyone else's perspective. I just want to hear yours.
And finally, have fun! Break the game, find cool combos, test the limits. And don't be afraid to dream big with your requests.
This is the menu you'll land on.
**Brand New** starts from the beginning, as if you had never played.
**Middle Progress** puts you a few dungeons in, with some items already unlocked.
**Continue** picks up your last playtest save.
**Feedback** opens a note to me. Use it for anything that is not tied to one card.
You can right-click any item or monster in the game and leave feedback. That is useful for bugs, confusion, or balance issues.
For general comments while you play, click **Feedback** in the bottom right, or press **F2**.

Consider taking your phone, setting it to a voice memo or recorder, and just letting it run while you play. Talk out loud about your thought process, your first impressions, your feedback, anything at all.

Then send me the entire file when you are done, because I can turn that into a much more detailed look at your player experience. If you are interested in doing that, you can email the files to me at nathan.elequin@gmail.com.
So thank you again for playtesting. If you have any questions, you can always reach out to me. Now enjoy!
